Name: All Boots Brown
Author: llehamsi
Description:
This mod is a new version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1878]Boots recolor - all brown (Content Patcher)[/url] with due permission granted by cathtail﻿.

The differences are that it is compatible with 1.6 and I chose to make the brown tone darker, as shown in the images.


[b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[/list]
[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
1. Download the file.
2. Extract the Folder.
3. Put said folder into:
﻿StardewValley\Mods.
4. Load with SMAPI.
5. Enjoy.

Manifest.Name: All Boots Brown
Manifest.Description: Change the color of all boots in the game to brown.
